title: AlertRule
description: An alert rule defining the condition and threshold that triggers an alert for an SAP HANA Cloud service instance. Rules can be cloud-native or embedded statistics server (ESS) based.

ruleId.description: The unique identifier of the alert rule.

ruleName.description: The human-readable name of the alert rule (e.g., Memory Usage Alert, Disk Full Alert).

enabled.description: Whether the alert rule is currently active.

severity.description: The severity level assigned to alerts triggered by this rule.

metric.description: The metric being monitored by this rule.

thresholdOperator.description: The comparison operator used to evaluate the threshold.

thresholdValue.description: The threshold value that triggers the alert when exceeded.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the threshold value.

description.description: A description of what this alert rule monitors.
